$comment: This file is generated from TypeScript source. Do not edit it manually; run npm run generate:schemas.

extensionChangelogVersions.description: Last seen changelog version per extension package.

modelThinkingLevels.description: Per-model default thinking level overrides keyed by "provider/modelId".

sessionShareDestination.description: Destination used by /share. "auto" uses Radius when authenticated and otherwise creates a GitHub gist.

modelOverrides.description: Per-model overrides keyed by exact "provider/modelId" strings.

reserveTokens.description: Tokens reserved for the prompt and LLM response.

skipPrompt.description: When true, skips the "Summarize branch?" prompt and defaults to no summary.

baseDelayMs.description: Exponential backoff base delay in milliseconds: 2s, 4s, 8s.

timeoutMs.description: SDK or provider request timeout in milliseconds.

maxDelayMs.description: Legacy retry delay setting. Use provider.maxRetryDelayMs instead.

staleEditGuard.description: Make edit and write fail on a file that was not read in this session or changed since it was read.

showCacheMissNotices.description: Show cache cost and provider recovery notices.

externalEditor.description: Command for Ctrl+G external editor; takes precedence over VISUAL and EDITOR.

shellPath.description: Custom shell path, for example for Cygwin on Windows, with support for leading ~ expansion.

quietStartup.description: When true, hide all startup output. When "header", keep only the startup header.

shellCommandPrefix.description: Prefix prepended to every bash command, for example to enable shell aliases.

npmCommand.description: Command used for npm package lookup and installation, in argv form such as ["mise", "exec", "node@20", "--", "npm"].

selfUpdateCommand.description: Command `pi update` runs to update Pi itself, in argv form such as ["mise", "use", "-g", "npm:{packageName}@{version}"]. Placeholders: {packageName}, {version}, {installSpec}. XPI_SELF_UPDATE_COMMAND takes precedence. Global setting only.

collapseChangelog.description: Show the condensed changelog after update; use /changelog for the full changelog.

enableInstallTelemetry.description: Send an anonymous version and update ping after changelog-detected updates.

enableAnalytics.description: Opt in to analytics data sharing.

trackingId.description: Analytics tracking identifier, generated when analytics is enabled.

anyOf.description: Load all resources from the package.

autoload.description: When false, start empty and only apply explicit resource patterns.

items.description: Package source for npm or git packages. Use the string form to load all resources or the object form to filter resources.

packages.description: npm or git package sources, as strings or objects with resource filtering.

extensions.description: Local extension file paths or directories.

deviceId.description: Stable installation UUID, generated when authentication first needs it. Global only.

skills.description: Local skill file paths or directories.

prompts.description: Local prompt template file paths or directories.

themes.description: Local theme file paths or directories.

showImages.description: Show images when the terminal supports them.

imageWidthCells.description: Preferred inline image width in terminal cells.

clearOnShrink.description: Clear empty rows when content shrinks.

autoResize.description: Resize images to 2000x2000 maximum for better model compatibility.

blockImages.description: When true, prevents all images from being sent to LLM providers.

enabledModels.description: Model patterns for cycling, in the same format as the --models CLI flag.

models.description: Model aliases shared by extensions (ctx.complete) and subagents, alias to a model reference such as "provider/id". subagent.models wins for subagents.

defaultTools.description: Initial tool selection. Plain names replace the inherited selection; +name and -name entries add or remove tools.

doubleEscapeAction.description: Action for double-escape with an empty editor.

thinkingBudgets.description: Custom token budgets for thinking levels.

editorPaddingX.description: Horizontal padding for the input editor.

autocompleteMaxVisible.description: Maximum visible items in the autocomplete dropdown.

showHardwareCursor.description: Show the terminal cursor while still positioning it for IME.

mode.description: How codemode presents tools. "on" keeps direct tools declared and annotates tools callable from scripts; codemode lists only tools without direct exposure. "only" lists every script-callable tool in codemode and does not declare active direct tools.

inlineBudget.description: Estimated tokens available for inline codemode tool declarations.

sessionDir.description: Custom session storage directory, in the same format as the --session-dir CLI flag.

httpProxy.description: Proxy URL applied as HTTP_PROXY and HTTPS_PROXY for Pi-managed HTTP clients.

httpIdleTimeoutMs.description: HTTP header or body idle timeout in milliseconds; 0 or "disabled" disables it.

cacheWarming.description: Cache-warming profile. "idle" also warms between agent runs. Global only because each refresh costs money.

websocketConnectTimeoutMs.description: WebSocket connect or open handshake timeout in milliseconds; 0 or "disabled" disables it.

fullscreenExitOutput.description: No effect in regular TUI mode.

fullscreenScrollbar.description: No effect in regular TUI mode.

fullscreenCopyOnSelect.description: No effect in regular TUI mode.

fullscreenWheelScrollLines.description: Lines scrolled per wheel event in fullscreen mode; numeric values are clamped from 1 to 100.

models.description: Model aliases for subagents, alias to "provider/model". Merged over the defaults for opus, sonnet, haiku and fable.

defaultModel.description: Model of an agent that names none: an alias or "provider/model"; "inherit" follows the session model. Default "haiku".

toolMap.description: Claude Code tool name to xpi tool name, merged over the built-in map.

maxConcurrent.description: Running subagents per xpi process; more calls queue. The first session's value holds for the process. Default 20.

maxAgentsPerScript.description: Agents one script run may start; the next Agent call throws. Default 1000.

childCodemode.description: "only" (default): subagents see only the codemode tool and call their tools from scripts. "inherit": direct tools.

backgroundScripts.description: A script that starts an Agent moves to the background. false: it waits for its agents. Default true.

fork.description: The "fork" agent type and /subtask. Default true.

staggerStart.description: Siblings with the same prompt prefix wait (at most 5 s) for the first one's response to begin, then read its cached prompt. Default false.

shutdownGraceMs.description: How long a stopped subagent may take to shut down before it is killed. Default 10000.

panelLingerMs.description: How long a finished subagent stays in the panel. Default 30000.

stallMs.description: A running subagent with no activity for this long is marked stalled in the panel and the user is told. 0 turns it off. Default 600000.

piCommand.description: Command that starts a subagent. Unset: the build this process runs.

subagent.description: Settings of the built-in subagent extension.

enabled.description: Turn agent teams on. XPI_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1 also does. Default false.

maxTeammates.description: Teammates that are not stopped (running, queued or idle) at once. Default 8.

taskRetentionDays.description: Task lists older than this many days are removed when a team is created. Default 30.

agentTeams.description: Experimental. Agent teams: an Agent call with `name` starts a teammate that messages the lead and other teammates. Read at session start and on /reload; only in the interactive TUI of a saved session.

lead.description: The model that explores, plans and reviews, as "provider/model". Default "anthropic/claude-opus-5-5".

worker.description: The model that builds, as "provider/model". Default "anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5".

leadThinking.description: The lead's thinking level before the first handover ("plan", default "high") and after a hand back ("review", default "medium").

maxRounds.description: Times failed acceptance commands go back to the worker before the lead is woken regardless. Default 3.

acceptanceTimeoutMs.description: Time limit of one acceptance command. Default 600000.

diffChars.description: How much of the diff goes into the hand-back record. Default 20000.

objective.description: What the user optimizes for, told to the lead, which decides with it whether to hand over. Default: a correct result for as few lead tokens as possible; worker tokens are not counted.

workerRecord.description: What is known about the worker's ability, told to the lead. Unset: nothing is said.

minuteCost.description: What one minute of the user's waiting is worth, in dollars of tokens, told to the lead next to the objective. Unset: time is not part of the objective.

relay.description: Settings of the built-in relay extension (the relay/auto model).

model.description: Model that drafts the message of /commit: an alias from the `models` setting, "provider/model", or "inherit" for the session model.

commit.description: Settings of the built-in commit extension (/commit).

leftArrowOpensAgents.description: The left arrow on an empty editor opens the hub. Default true.

reapIdleMinutes.description: A background session idle, unattached and unpinned this long is stopped (it can be started again). Default 60.

cleanupDays.description: Records of sessions that ended this many days ago are removed; 0 keeps them. Default 30.

dispatchModel.description: Model of a new background session, "provider/model".

dispatchThinking.description: Thinking level of a new background session.

inheritEnv.description: A session starts with the launching shell's environment (less envDenyList); false: envAllowList only. User settings only. Default true.

envAllowList.description: Variables carried even when inheritEnv is off or envDenyList names them. User settings only. Default [].

envDenyList.description: Variables never carried; "PREFIX*" names a prefix. User settings only. Default [].

workspaceEnv.description: The session directory's own environment on top: its shell's cd hooks ("shell"), direnv only, or "off". User settings only. Default "shell".

groupBy.description: How the hub groups sessions. Default "state".

fullscreen.description: The hub covers the whole terminal (false: below the conversation). Default true.

rowDetails.description: Each row of the hub shows its model and context use. Default true.

notify.description: How the hub makes the terminal notify. Default "auto".

model.description: Model of a new session, as "provider/model".

thinking.description: Thinking level of a new session.

dir.description: Directory of a new session, relative to the hub's (never above it).

presets.description: Saved choices for new sessions, by name (the user's and a project's merged, a project's winning).

roost.description: Settings of xpi roost (background sessions and the hub).
